localizedValues.description: The Lakelse Lake Group Campsite is located within the Lakelse Lake Picnic Site across from the BC Parks Office on Hwy 37 south of Terrace. The site accommodates up to 200 persons and is composed of 8 camp sites (4 double sites), a parking area, picnic shelter (with woodstove, electricity and water), pit toilets, lake access, and a large field for games and tenting.
